transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, my eating has just been all turned around. It's been like this for months now. Some days I just pick at a piece of toast and have some coffee. And then other days... I don't know, I just find myself standing in the bakery aisle buying sweets. I don't even really enjoy them.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over these months?

No, not really... it's just what I said before. My eating is just turned around. Some days it's just toast, and other days I'm buying sweets I don't even want. My weight hasn't really changed much, though.
Do you ever feel like you're eating a large amount of food in a short period of time, and can't stop yourself?
No... not really. I don't think so. I just... I just buy the sweets sometimes. But I wouldn't say I'm eating a huge amount all at once or anything.
Do you feel guilty after buying or eating those sweets?
I mean... I guess maybe a little? But not really guilty, just... confused why I bought them. I don't really think about it that much.
Do you worry about gaining weight?
No... not really. I just don't really pay attention to that.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No... like I said, I'm not. It's just not something I really care about.
Do you ever feel like you're losing control when you're eating?
No... I don't think so. I just eat normally, I guess. I don't feel out of control or anything.
Do you usually buy or eat sweets when you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset?

I guess... I mean, my eating has just been all turned around for months now. Some days I just pick at toast and coffee. And then... yeah, other days I'll just stand in the bakery aisle buying sweets. I don't even really enjoy them, so... I don't know.
Do you buy sweets when you're feeling stressed or upset?
I don't know... I'm not really sure if it's because I'm stressed. I just... I don't really pay attention to why I'm buying them. It just happens.
Do you think your mood has anything to do with why you buy sweets on some days?
I'm not really sure... I don't really think about my mood. I just... I don't know, I just buy them sometimes.
Do you think your eating sweets has anything to do with trying to feel better when you're not in a good mood?

I... I don't think it makes me feel better. Like I was saying before, I don't even really enjoy them when I buy them. It's just... my eating has been all turned around for months now. Going from just picking at toast and coffee to... standing there buying all those sweets. I really don't know why it happens.
Do you think you buy sweets when you're feeling down or emotional?
I... I really couldn't say. I don't... I just don't think there's a reason like that. It just happens.
Do you think your mood or feelings have anything to do with the days you eat very little, like just toast and coffee?
I don't think so... I just don't have much of an appetite most days. I don't really sit and think about how I'm feeling when I make my coffee. I'm just... not hungry.
Do you think your emotions influence what you eat on a given day?

I... I really don't know. Like I said, I don't think there's a connection like that. I'm just trying to get through the day... I don't really pay attention to my feelings when it comes to food. It just is what it is.
Do you think your emotions play a role in your decision to eat sweets on certain days?

I... I don't really know why we keep going back to my emotions. I just... I came in because my eating has been all turned around for months now. That's really it. Like I said, some days I just pick at my toast and coffee, and... then other days I just end up standing in the bakery aisle buying sweets. Sweets I don't even really enjoy. I don't know why, I just do it.
Do you think eating sweets or picking at toast and coffee helps you deal with difficult feelings?

I... no. I don't think it helps with anything. I'm really not doing it to cope with... feelings. I just eat what I eat, or I don't. It doesn't make anything better or worse. I don't really know what else to say about it.
Do you think there's any emotional reason behind why you have days where you barely eat and days where you buy a lot of sweets?
I... I don't know why you're still asking me this. I already told you, I don't think so. I just... I don't know why I do it. I just do.
Do you think your eating habits change in response to emotional events or stressors in your life?
I... I really don't think so. I mean... I don't see any connection. It's just... it just happens. I don't know what else you want me to say about it.
Do you think your eating habits are related to trying to manage or regulate your emotions?
I... I feel like we're just going in circles now. I don't know how many different ways I can say no. It's not about my emotions. I just... I don't know why we keep talking about this.
Do you think your eating habits are a way for you to deal with feelings or emotions?
I... I really don't have a different answer for you. No. It's not. I just... can we please talk about something else? I don't want to talk about the food anymore.
